info.title: RoofRoof REST API
info.summary: The REST API of a RoofRoof roll-off-roof controller.
info.description:
Every `/api/*` route a RoofRoof roll-off-roof controller serves on port 80. Generated from the firmware's route registry and its contract schemas, so it matches the device.

**The same in every language**: numbers are JSON numbers with `.` as the decimal point, units and field names are never translated, and timestamps are Unix seconds or ISO 8601. Text for people (alert `title` and `message`, `error`) may be reworded between releases: key on the alert `event`, not its text.

**Password**: when protection is on, routes that change something need HTTP Basic auth with the device's username and password.

**ASCOM Alpaca** (`/api/v1/*`, `/management/*`) follows the ASCOM Alpaca standard and isn't repeated here. The device offers one Alpaca device, the roof as a Dome (`/api/v1/dome/0/*`); it has no password (the Alpaca design), and its open and close pass the same safety checks as the REST commands. See https://ascom-standards.org/api/.

Open: Read-only status for integrations.

post.description:
Partial update: only the fields sent change. A masked or empty password keeps the stored one; `null` clears it. A wrong value is refused with `error` naming it; a setting whose dependency is off is saved and reported inactive by `/api/settings/effective`. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing or a close is waiting to start (flash writes stall its control task); while the save runs, an open is refused and a close waits for it.

Needs the password when protection is on.

put.description:
The same as `POST /api/config`, for clients that use PUT. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing or a close is waiting to start (flash writes stall its control task); while the save runs, an open is refused and a close waits for it.

Needs the password when protection is on.

post.description:
Restarts the device after answering. Refused with 409 (with the reason) while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing.

Needs the password when protection is on.

Asks the roof to open, as a person. Refused unless the weather verdict is safe (constitution III), and by the motion logic (a latched fault, the Hall reading not settled, the supply low or unreadable, current sense on and unreadable, invalid settings), and with `busy` while an upload or command-line OTA is writing the flash, an MQTT connect is under way or a restart is scheduled. An accepted open starts after the 500 ms dead time and ends on the open magnet; `GET /api/status` `roof` shows its progress. An open in progress stops if the weather stops being safe. Refused with `hotspot` while the setup hotspot, which has no password, is on. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`.

Needs the password when protection is on.

post.description:
Asks the roof to close, as a person. Refused unless the mount is confirmed parked: N.I.N.A. reports it at park and every fitted park switch reads closed (constitution II); refused by the motion logic as for open. A close in progress stops with a `parkInterlock` fault if the park confirmation is lost. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`. A close always wins: it cancels a scheduled restart and stops an upload in progress (the upload fails with 409). While an upload, another flash write or an MQTT connect is still finishing, the close is accepted with 202 and `pending: true` and starts as soon as it is done (`roof.closePending` in the status).

Needs the password when protection is on.

post.description:
Spec 016: an attended run, started only by a person at the roof. From where the roof is, a slow close to the closed end (unless `at` is `closed`), a slow open and a slow close, and with `topPass` an open and a close at the top duty; each leg stops at the first magnet and is bounded by `roof.calibrationLimitSeconds` (later legs by the measured ones), the existing faults and the drive budget. Refused (409, with `reason` and `error`) unless `attended` is true, the weather is safe, daylight doesn't want the roof closed, the mount is confirmed parked, the automatic close is idle, no fault is latched, the roof is at rest, nothing blocks an open and the Hall reading agrees with `at`. Reasons: `notAttended`, `calibrating`, `closeSequence`, `faultLatched`, `moving`, `closeWaiting`, `settingsPending`, `weatherNotSafe`, `daylight`, `mountNotParked`, `busy`, `hotspot`, `restarting`, `invalid`, `hallDisagrees`, `notStarted`, or the motion logic's (`supplyLow`, `supplyUnreadable`, `currentUnreadable`, `hallNotSettled`, `settingsInvalid`). Read the run with `GET /api/roof/calibration`. Nothing is saved: the proposal is accepted with `POST /api/config`. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`.

Needs the password when protection is on.

post.description:
After the slow open the run waits (phase `confirm`, at most 5 minutes) for the person at the roof to say whether the roof is now at its open end: the one check of the motor's direction the run can't make itself. `true` carries on with the slow close; `false` ends the run (`wrongEnd`) with nothing proposed. 409 `notWaiting` when the run isn't waiting for it. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`.

Needs the password when protection is on.

get.description:
Spec 016: the last calibration run since start-up (`idle` before any): its state, the leg under way with its limit, how it ended, each measured leg (time, duty, end level, speed at 100 % duty, current and supply), the Hall readings (in between, and at rest at each end) and, for a finished run, the proposal with the value at the start beside each proposed one (`null` where withheld, with the reason). Read-only, kept in memory only.

Open: Read-only: the calibration run's readings and proposal; no address or secret; changes nothing.

The weather verdict with each SQMeter source's state and reason, the park result, and N.I.N.A.'s last mount reading (connected, at park, slewing), as the device last polled them. Read-only: it sends nothing to SQMeter or N.I.N.A. The setup wizard's Tests read it.

Open: Read-only: the weather sources, the park and N.I.N.A. as the device last polled them; no address or secret; sends nothing.

Everything the controller measures now: the supply and its sag, the motor current and power, the duty, direction and ramp phase, the driver's EN and PWM levels, the Hall reading, the position estimate with the elapsed and remaining time and the timeout, the drive budget, the control task's step time and gap, the watchdog margin, the main loop's pass time, memory, stacks, Wi-Fi signal, uptime and reset reason. The same document streams on /ws/diag. With advanced diagnostics off it is {"enabled": false}.

Open: Read-only: the live diagnostics readings (spec 017), like /api/status; no address or secret; {"enabled": false} while diagnostics are off.

The last 32 move summaries, newest first, each saying whether its profile is still held (the last 5 moves). The same handler serves /api/diag/moves/{id}: one move with its summary and downsampled profile (404 when it isn't held), or with ?format=csv the profile as a CSV download. With advanced diagnostics off the list is {"enabled": false}.

Open: Read-only: the move log's summaries and one move's profile (/api/diag/moves/{id}, JSON or CSV); readings only, changes nothing.

post.description:
Empties the move log and the summary list, and the kept summaries at the next flash write the device allows. Needs the X-RoofRoof: 1 header. Refused while the roof moves or a close waits, so the move in progress isn't lost.

Needs the password when protection is on.

403.description: Refused: a required header is missing

post.description:
Reads a backup file (`backup`, its text or its JSON) and, with its `passphrase`, its secrets, and answers what applying would save: the settings (masked), which secrets change, settings this board can't use and why it would restart. Nothing is applied; the `token` binds this preview to `POST /api/backup/apply`. Refused with `code` `not-backup`, `damaged`, `newer-format`, `wrong-passphrase` or `invalid` (the save's own reason in `error`).

Needs the password when protection is on.

413.description: The request body is too large

backup.description: The backup file's text, or its JSON.

post.description:
Saves exactly the settings the preview with this `token` showed, as one settings save, and restarts the device about 2 s later when `restarting` is true. 409 `stale` when the preview was already applied or replaced, is older than 10 minutes, or the settings changed since: preview again. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing or a close is waiting to start (flash writes stall its control task), and, when it would restart, also while the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing.

Needs the password when protection is on.

The backup file: every setting as `GET /api/config` shows it, with a header. With a `passphrase` (8 characters or more) the passwords, keys and tokens are included encrypted (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256); without one the file holds no secret. Answered from a background task: a second or two with a passphrase. Refusals carry a `code`: 400 `passphrase-short`, 409 `busy` while another backup or preview runs, 413 `too-large`.

Needs the password when protection is on.

413.description: The request body is too large

get.description:
The first call starts a background scan and answers 202 with `scanning: true`; call again about once a second until `scanning` is false and the list arrives. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing (the radio leaves its channel during a scan); while a scan runs (at most 15 s), an open is refused and a close waits.

Needs the password when protection is on.

post.description:
Tries to connect with the given details without saving them. A `password` of `********` (the mask settings return) or empty means the saved password, which is only used when broker, port and username match the saved ones; for any other broker a masked password is refused with 400.

Needs the password when protection is on.

What the WiFi setup screen uses. Answers 202 at once; poll `/api/status` (`wifi.connectPending`, then `wifi.connected`). On success the network is saved and the device restarts onto it 15 s later. Send `""` as the password for an open network. Refused with 409 (with the reason) while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing: it drops the current network for up to 10 s. Until it has joined (at most 15 s), an open is refused and a close waits.

Needs the password when protection is on.

A LittleFS image that fills the web UI partition exactly. A file for another layout is refused before anything is erased. Settings are kept. Refused with 409 (with the reason) while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing (flash writes stall the control task, and the restart after it can't be cancelled). An upload in progress is stopped by a roof close (409, "Upload stopped: the roof is closing").

Needs the password when protection is on.

A firmware `.bin` for this device's build and partition layout. 400 when the file is for another layout (nothing changed); 500 keeps the running firmware. The device restarts on success. Refused with 409 (with the reason) before anything is written while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing (a new firmware may not read what it keeps across a restart); the restart after it waits for the roof and the close. An upload in progress is stopped by a roof close (409, "Upload stopped: the roof is closing").

Needs the password when protection is on.

Queues a test on the given saved, switched-on channel(s); see `/api/alerts/recent` for the result. A channel that can't deliver right now is recorded as `skipped`. Add `event`, `level` and `sound` for a sample of that event, or `title`/`message` to try custom wording with `{variables}`.

Needs the password when protection is on.

Empties the recent-alerts list.

Needs the password when protection is on.

Takes effect at once and survives restarts.

Needs the password when protection is on.

While paused nothing is sent. Takes effect at once and survives restarts.

Needs the password when protection is on.

get.description:
Whether alerts are being sent, the send mode and why it's sending or paused.

Open: Read-only: sending or paused, and why.

Whether alerts are on, and the last 20 since boot, newest first, with each channel's delivery result (`pending`, `sent`, `failed`, `skipped`).

Open: Read-only recent alerts (no secrets).

deviceLogin.description: The device's username and password, when protection is on.

roofCommand.name: X-RoofRoof
roofCommand.description: Must be `1`. A cross-site form or simple cross-origin request can't send it, so another site in a browser can't move the roof (403 without it).

source.name: source
source.description: `ui` when the web UI sends it; shown as the reason.

ActionResult.title: Action result
ActionResult.description: What every action endpoint answers on a 2xx status, success true plus details; on a 4xx/5xx status, an error message. Hand-written, not generated: tools/contract-check.py checks the device's actions against it.

Backup.title: Backup
Backup.description: POST /api/backup (src/WebServerBackup.cpp, lib/ConfigBackup): the settings backup file, format 1. Hand-written, not generated.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC; left out when the device clock wasn't set.

settings.description: Every setting as GET /api/config shows it: a set secret is "********", an empty one "".

secrets.description: Only with a passphrase: the eight secrets, encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key.

data.description: Base64 ciphertext followed by the 16-byte tag; associated data "roofroof-backup/1".

BackupPreview.title: BackupPreview
BackupPreview.description: POST /api/backup/preview (src/WebServerBackup.cpp, lib/ConfigBackup): what restoring a backup would save, before anything is applied. Hand-written, not generated.

token.description: 32 hex characters; send it to POST /api/backup/apply.

backup.description: The file's header, as far as it has one (format 0 is a plain settings export).

settings.description: The settings applying would save, secrets masked as in GET /api/config.

state.description: restored: decrypted with the passphrase; kept: the file has secrets but no passphrase was given; none: the file has none.

changed.description: Secret paths that will change (never values).

notApplicable.description: Settings in the backup this board can't use: not applied, this board's value is kept.

value.description: The backup's value (left out for a secret).

restart.description: Why applying restarts the device; empty: no restart.

WifiScan.title: WiFi scan
WifiScan.description: GET /api/wifi/scan (src/WebServerApi.cpp handleWiFiScan). The scan runs in the background: 202 with scanning true and no networks while it runs, then 200 with the list. Hand-written, not generated.
